text: README.md documents `og clean` as the safe cleanup entrypoint, with `runtime`, `generated`, and `all` scopes. The documented scope mapping includes `.outcomegraph/work`, `cache`, `events`, `objects`, and `traces` for `runtime`; `.outcomegraph/capsules`, `refs`, `decisions`, `claims`, `certificates`, `export`, and `materials.lock` for `generated`; and `.outcomegraph`, `skills/outcome-steward`, `.agents/skills/og`, and `.claude/skills/og` for `all`.
